title: Pencil with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pencil body (yellow) -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='24' height='52' rx='3' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- Pencil facet shading -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='8' height='52' rx='2' fill='#FFE87A'/>
  <rect x='56' y='30' width='6' height='52' rx='2' fill='#E8A800'/>
  <!-- Eraser band (metal) -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='24' height='9' rx='2' fill='#C0C8D8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='8' height='9' rx='2' fill='#E4EAF4'/>
  <!-- Eraser (pink) -->
  <rect x='39' y='10' width='22' height='13' rx='5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <rect x='39' y='10' width='7' height='13' rx='4' fill='#FFB9C8'/>
  <!-- Wood cone -->
  <polygon points='38,82 62,82 50,94' fill='#F2C48A'/>
  <polygon points='38,82 46,82 50,94' fill='#FFDDB0'/>
  <!-- Graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='46,89 54,89 50,97' fill='#5B4B8A'/>
  <!-- Face on pencil body -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='3' fill='#5B4B8A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='3' fill='#5B4B8A'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='47' r='1' fill='#FFF6C9'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='47' r='1' fill='#FFF6C9'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 58 Q50 66 57 58' stroke='#5B4B8A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='3' fill='#FF9FB2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='56' r='3' fill='#FF9FB2' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
